# UXDL: User Experience Description Language
> Machine-readable specification language for observable product behavior.

## Overview
UXDL defines product behavior through screens, states, actions, and relations. It serves as a deterministic behavioral contract between humans and autonomous AI coding agents.

## Core Documentation
- [Overview & Principles](spec/overview.md): Core problem, hypothesis, and principles
- [Normative Specification](spec/specification.md): Canonical grammar, syntax, addresses, and semantics
- [Versioning & Compatibility](spec/versioning.md): Versioning rules and change classifications

## Extension Profiles
- [Slices Extension](profiles/slices.md): Grouping flows into traceable delivery slices and user journeys
- [Multi-File Project Profile](profiles/multi-file.md): Packaging modular UXDL files into a composed project
- [AI Agent Harness](profiles/agent-harness.md): Thinker, Builder, and Reviewer task execution contracts
- [PRD Profile](profiles/prd-profile.md): Completeness rules for turning PRDs into verifiable contracts
- [Readiness Profile](profiles/readiness.md): Grading implementation readiness and tracking specification gaps

## Canonical Examples
- [Team Workspace Reference Project](examples/team-workspace/uxdl.project.yaml): Multi-file SaaS reference project

## Syntax Quick Reference
```yaml
uxdl: "0.1"
app: AppName
actors:
  actor_id: { name: "Human Name", type: human | system | external }
screens:
  screen_id:
    name: "Screen Title"
    type: page | modal | sheet | drawer | section
    states:
      state_id: { name: "State Title" }
    actions:
      action_id:
        name: "Action Title"
        actor: actor_id
        relations:
          relation_id:
            to: target_screen | target_screen.states.state_id
            path: happy | error | guard | cancel | retry | edge | fallback
            when: optional condition description
```
